parsed.post: Kept: MATRIX_LR 0.05 on DEPTH=8/clean shards 0-9 gave 1.019542 -> 0.986583. Lower LR clearly helps the deeper model. Next: MATRIX_LR=0.02 on DEPTH=8, warmup 0.05, batch 262144, clean shards 0-9. Shard 10 remains eval-only.
parsed.description: Reduce MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.02 on depth-8 clean config to test whether lower learning rate improves convergence further.
